tickets.goal: In octopus/capabilities.py, introduce one small private helper named _normalize_enum_value that performs exactly the existing enum-like string normalization (strip, lowercase, replace hyphen with underscore, replace ordinary space with underscore) and use it from _coerce_enum. Preserve every public API, alias, error behavior, ordering rule, and evaluation semantic. Do not modify tests or any other file.
acceptance_criteria: _normalize_enum_value contains exactly the previous normalization semantics
no new import or module-level side effect is introduced
public capability behavior and aliases remain unchanged
the existing capability oracle passes with the same PASSED node set as the baseline

acceptance_criteria: _enum_expected_values centralizes only the repeated enum expected-values rendering

tickets.goal: In octopus/capabilities.py, introduce one small private helper named _normalize_lower_text that performs exactly strip().lower() for strings.
